# arduinoWebSockets 2.7.2 in ProgHard Link

This directory contains an unmodified export of the upstream
`arduinoWebSockets` release used by ProgHard Link Base 0.2.3.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/Links2004/arduinoWebSockets
- Upstream tag: `2.7.2`
- Annotated tag object: `012d2f40b7d5c4e6b8259a09e24a222a2dda6670`
- Tagged commit: `8d0744eb5e916ec646d83bd1ffed5f643aab04d8`
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later
- Local modifications: none

`source/` is a `git archive`-equivalent export of every file tracked by that
tag. `LICENSE` is an unchanged convenience copy of `source/LICENSE`; both have
SHA-256 `510ccb0ba9b0a9bf99343901040a8ec42f92310704203d2068cea815cbbabb8f`.

Official firmware builds select `source/` explicitly. See
[`docs/third-party-relinking.md`](../../docs/third-party-relinking.md) for a
testable modification, rebuild and flashing procedure.
